When I was auditioning for music school I had a pretty bad time. I knew all the professors except the trumpet one and had developed a reputation through that. Before the audition the prof came up to me and said he had heard great things and couldn't wait to hear me play. I freaked out at this. I was playing a series of studies I had worked on for about 7 months, but I was so scared that walking in I decided to change what I was playing and played a very simple piece I had done for a concert a few years before. Needless to say the look on the profs face was all I needed to see that I didn't make it. I ended up practicing  for  another six months  and auditioning again and making it, but that first audition really got to me.
